clauses.quote: Lane change appeals will be directed to the Human Resources office.
Paychecks will be made available to employees on the last district working day of each month, except as may be otherwise provided below.
December paychecks will be issued prior to Winter Recess for employees who have no further working days in December.
payments of withholdings to the credit union, annuity companies, and various other insurance agencies will not necessarily be remitted on the day paychecks are issued.
clauses.subject_text: payments of withholdings to the credit union, annuity companies, and various other insurance agencies
clauses.notes: Negated passive obligation relieves management of strict remittance timing.

clauses.quote: All employees paid from the teachers’ salary schedule, who by regular assignment, must travel between two or more district schools or approved locations on the same day will receive an automobile allowance each month for the term of their contract.
clauses.subject_text: All employees paid from the teachers’ salary schedule, who by regular assignment, must travel between two or more district schools or approved locations on the same day

clauses.quote: In addition to the above automobile allowances, all employees of the District are entitled to mileage reimbursement according to the terms of Administrative Memorandum Number Thirty Five.
Before reporting for duty, teachers employed under this Agreement shall comply with all necessary licensure and/or endorsement requirements of the Utah State Board of Education.
The licenses specified above must be registered with the Human Resources within thirty days following the beginning date of employment.
clauses.notes: Passive construction implies worker duty to register.

clauses.quote: The teacher agrees to follow the rules, regulations, and policies of the Board and to perform the duties assigned to the teacher under the direction of the principal and the Superintendent, at the time and place appointed by the Board or the Board's designee.

Acts in violation of this Agreement, or of the rules; regulations; and policies of the Board, or failure to perform duties assigned to the teacher, may constitute a breach of contract and subject the teacher to disciplinary action
clauses.subject_text: Acts in violation of this Agreement, or of the rules; regulations; and policies of the Board, or failure to perform duties assigned to the teacher
clauses.notes: Defines consequences; not a direct Hohfeldian grant.
